newsitem.title: UK: Ex-wife of Yorkshire Ripper weds again in Britain.
newsitem.headline: Ex-wife of Yorkshire Ripper weds again in Britain.

text.p: Sonia Sutcliffe, formerly married to the Yorkshire Ripper, has re-wed three years after her divorce from one of Britain's most notorious murderers.
Sonia, 46, married 37-year-old Michael Woodward on Friday in the northern England town of Shipley, West Yorkshire, the priest who conducted the ceremony said on Saturday.
The couple are due to go on honeymoon in the next few days.
Sonia still lives in the Bradford house that she shared with the Yorkshire Ripper until his conviction for the murder of 13 women in 1981.

Peter Sutcliffe -- who became known as the Ripper for the brutal nature of his attacks -- is currently serving a life sentence in Broadmoor Hospital, where mentally ill prisoners are held. Earlier this year he was almost blinded after an attack by a fellow inmate.
Six police officers attended Friday's church ceremony, fearing possible violence.
